preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The input indices must be a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: All elements in the indices list must be integers.
The length of the string s must be equal to the length of the indices list.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(s) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: All indices must be within the bounds of the string s.

postconditions.expression: all(s[indices[i]] == return_value[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The character at position i in the return value must be the character at position indices[i] in the input string s.
